title: SDLC Any Reference v1
description: A string containing any supported SDLC reference scope: a bare work-item ID, bare task UID, task-local reference, work-item-local reference, task-qualified reference, or globally qualified repository reference.
$comment: SdlcAnyReference is a syntactic union of bare identities, task-local, work-item-local, task-qualified, and global references. Use {WorkItemId} for a bare work-item identity, {TaskUid} for a bare canonical task identity, #<entity-kind>/<entity-id> for the current task, {WorkItemId}#{filename}#{entity-kind}/{entity-id} for a work-item artifact, {TaskIdentifier}#<entity-kind>/<entity-id> for another task, and either global form from SdlcReference across repositories. Host validation must resolve the selected scope and entity when semantic resolution is requested; this schema validates only the string form.

oneOf.description: A canonical task-local reference rooted at intent or result and expressed as a JSON-path-like selector.
A task-local reference resolved against the current task payload or result.
A work-item-local reference resolved against the selected work-item directory.
A task-qualified reference resolved against the named task.

anyOf.description: A globally qualified repository reference resolved against a repository, task, and entity.
A globally qualified repository reference resolved against a repository, work-item artifact, and entity.
